I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL database backend:

1. In [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2hkiixjg/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L206) ([base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2hkiixjg/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py)), replaced the deprecated `'db'` and `'passwd'` keyword arguments with `'database'` and `'password'`.
2. In [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2hkiixjg/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L14) ([client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-2hkiixjg/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py)), added support for the `'database'` key in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `'db'` and `settings_dict['NAME']`), matching the existing handling of `'password'` and `'passwd'`.
